name: Salome
source:
[i]"From the very first day she arrived at this orphanage... Not once have I seen misfortune occur because of her."[/i]

A Reliver and mother to many at the orphanage. She is very wise and has some knowledge of medicine, which she uses to suppress the symptoms of illness caused by the heroine's "misfortune."

[b]Occupation:[/b] Orphanage matron

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Christine Rêvepoir (クリスティーヌ・レーヴポワール).[/spoiler]
